summary_md: **두디 Doodi ([@doodi_dev](https://x.com/doodi_dev/status/2116715600009453764))** introduces **Ariadne**, an AGPL offline knowledge memory for agents that unifies Kiwix archives (Wikipedia, Stack Exchange, docs, books) behind one MCP server with eight tools, answering with sources, translating locally and running CPU-only even on 2009-era Xeons ([VivaldiCode/Ariadne](https://github.com/VivaldiCode/Ariadne)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - VivaldiCode/Ariadne: Offline knowledge memory for AI agents: Kiwix + Wiki.js + pgvector over MCP and REST. CPU only, no GPU or AVX needed.

relevance: Offline grounded knowledge for local agents.

media.description: Ariadne web UI "Reading" page with a unified offline library search over Kiwix, Wiki.js and a semantic index, showing Wikipedia results for photosynthesis.
